_comment: W4.4 origin 5 — URL lists from the team's web-search model. Only ever URLs to INSPECT (robots, terms, feed probe, automatic decision); never events to ingest. The 2026-10-14 sample's events had all already happened, carried no dates or places, and four of five were already in Verdure; the one new host it found is first. The 2026-10-25 additions (CAC 2026, 1.1 cause 5) are the South Bay outdoor, parks, land-trust, nature-centre and volunteer organisations the pipeline's existing adapters (wordpress-tec, jsonld, rss-ics, ics) could serve; each is inspected under the same six rules, and a host whose robots.txt or terms refuse automated access is rejected with the evidence recorded, never parsed. Deny-listed platforms (Meetup, Eventbrite, Facebook, Google) are refused before inspection. evols.org was inspected live on 2026-10-25 and came back unknown (its sitemap lists no event pages), so it is left for the monthly re-inspection rather than kept here.
